steps.title: Define Project Scope & Architecture
steps.description: Establish the 3D Calculator Pro architecture containing custom recursive-descent math parsers and physical 3D-beveled button elements.

steps.title: Configure Build Tools & Target SDK
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target/compile SDK 34, Java 17 toolchain, and compatible legacy dependencies using pure Android SDK libraries.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish launch capabilities, orientations, and custom hardware accelerations for fluid 3D transformations.

steps.title: Create Color Palette & Theme Configuration
steps.description: Define custom neon glowing accent parameters, mechanical shadow colors, and skeuomorphic gradients.

steps.title: Develop Mechanical Number Keys 3D Drawable
steps.description: Construct state-list layer drawables with deep bevel offsets that realistically compress downwards during user interaction.

steps.title: Develop Operator Keys 3D Drawable
steps.description: Design physical-style amber keys for arithmetic operators with distinct tactile feedback shadows.

steps.title: Develop Action Keys 3D Drawable
steps.description: Create vivid warning-styled crimson actuators for delete and calculation reset events.

steps.title: Develop Scientific Keys 3D Drawable
steps.description: Develop modern deep cobalt keys representing complex scientific algorithms and algebraic operators.

steps.title: Develop Mechanical Toggle Drawables
steps.description: Create active and inactive latching drawables for mechanical mode selectors.

steps.title: Develop Skeuomorphic LCD Glass Screen Drawable
steps.description: Configure multi-level layer stroke borders simulating a physical inset LCD screen with neon retro backlighting.

steps.title: Develop Main Metal Body Plate Texture
steps.description: Design an industrial brushed plate gradient representing the physical structural casing of the calculator.

steps.title: Design 3D Skeuomorphic Interface Markup
steps.description: Build an exhaustive structural layout including retro glowing LCD, status panels, and a hidden high-fidelity sliding drawer.

steps.title: Implement Scientific Evaluator and Parser Engine
steps.description: Write a pure mathematical compiler supporting parentheses, powers, roots, trigonometric, log, factorial, and constant configurations.

steps.title: Implement Tactical Response and Dynamic Interface Mechanics
steps.description: Connect mechanical button listeners, dynamic haptic vibrations, scientific layout sliders, and live local storage calculation logs.

steps.title: Building 3D Calculator Pro
steps.description: Assemble the project compiler packages and test structural consistency.
